clues: This place is one part of the city of Riga. It sits on the right bank of the Daugava River.
This is one of the driest parts of all Riga. That dry feel is rare for a place so close to a river.
In 1924, this land became part of Riga. The plan was a garden city of small homes with gardens all around.
In the 1970s, some small homes here were torn down. New apartment blocks were built for Soviet Army officers.
Check its split look as you walk through it. Low homes fill the west, and big blocks fill the north-west.
